card.name: Comparison or threshold words before 'of/than'
card.fires_on: Words that set up a quantity or comparison and expect 'of' or 'than' next, such as '%' after 50, 'better' after 'probably', 'worsening' after 'inducing', and 'energy' after 'save more'.

modes.label: Percent threshold
modes.description: The % sign after a minimum figure in pass-mark rules, followed by 'of the marks'.
modes.example: students must obtain at least 50<<%>> of the marks available for each assessment item

modes.label: Comparative or change word
modes.description: A word of degree or change that is followed by 'than' or 'of'.
modes.example: Probably<< better>> than average, or so you might think

modes.label: Worsening of a condition
modes.description: The word 'worsening' after 'inducing', leading into 'of depression'.
modes.example: antidepressants may have a role in inducing<< worsening>> of depression and the emergence of suicid
